_meta.title: FMECA register — full equipment park, maintenance-plan prioritization
client_arbitration_2026_08_15: 1. SCOPE = the FULL equipment park: the 35 electrical_loads consumers of data/default_parameters.json as the equipment nomenclature + the process machines' engine sheets; diverters (DV.GF, sliver) and silos added as non-electrical in-scope items.
2. CRITICALITY = RPN = S x O x D, each scored 1-10 (RPN 1-1000); action thresholds >= 200 CRITICAL / 100-199 WATCH.
3. SEVERITY anchor MIXED: 9-10 safety/environment; 6-8 full line stop; production severity set from ENGINE knowledge (single points high, redundant lower, quality-critical screens mid-high).
4. OCCURRENCE = generic reliability classes by equipment type [H], MODULATED by engine load factors (docs/design/maintenance/fmeca-engine-evidence.json).
5. DELIVERABLE = this data-first register (.json) + .md printout + preventive-maintenance-plan.md sorted by RPN + dated decision-log row + CLAUDE.md pointer.

S_severity.8: single-point failure stopping a whole production chain, repair > 1 week
S_severity.7: single-point chain stop, repair 1-7 days — or quality breach on a FIRM commitment with thin margin
S_severity.6: full chain stop < 1 day, or quality nonconformity reaching a committed product
S_severity.5: partial capacity loss / quality deviation caught before shipment
S_severity.4: redundancy or stockpile absorbs; reduced rate

scales.O_modulation_rule: generic class per equipment type [H], then +1 per ~90-120 % engine load factor, +2 above ~115 % or engine-certain duty exceedance; -1 where annual hours are far below continuous-plant baseline

D_detection.3-4: caught by routine rounds or existing monitoring
D_detection.5-6: found only by scheduled inspection/measurement (PSD, vibration route, thermography)
